beats.text: Old AI models read sentences one single word at a time. Like a painful ticker tape.
beats.visual_focus: A glowing ticker tape feeds words sequentially into a slow mechanical reader while GPU cores sit dark.

visual_blueprint.title: THE SEQUENTIAL BOTTLENECK
visual_blueprint.sub: Tokens queue single-file through recurrent hidden states

motif_params.title: THE SEQUENTIAL BOTTLENECK
motif_params.sub: Tokens queue single-file through recurrent hidden states

beats.text: Recurrent loops forced GPUs into a sequential bottleneck. Word five had to wait for word four. Leaving millions in silicon stalled.
beats.visual_focus: A locked gate halts token five while token four processes; GPU tensor cores blink red in idle wait states.

visual_blueprint.title: IDLE SILICON
visual_blueprint.sub: O(n) sequential dependency blocks parallel execution

motif_params.title: IDLE SILICON
motif_params.sub: O(n) sequential dependency blocks parallel execution

beats.text: The Transformer killed the loop entirely. Instead of waiting in line. It ingests an entire document at the exact same instant.
beats.visual_focus: The sequential chain dissolves into a parallel grid; all tokens simultaneously ignite in bright emerald light.

visual_blueprint.title: ATTENTION IS ALL YOU: FIGURE
visual_blueprint.sub: The sequential chain dissolves into a parallel grid; all tokens

beats.text: Each token projects a Query, Key, and Value vector. A single matrix multiplication maps every word's relationship to every other word simultaneously.
beats.visual_focus: Geometric vectors project out from tokens into Query and Key planes, colliding into a glowing N-by-N attention score heatmap.

visual_blueprint.title: SELF-ATTENTION MATRIX
visual_blueprint.sub: Softmax(Q * K^T / sqrt(d_k)) * V computes global context in parallel

beats.text: It crushed state-of-the-art translation benchmarks in just three and a half days on eight GPUs. Slashing training costs dramatically.
beats.visual_focus: A horizontal bar race displays the Transformer shooting past prior ensemble models while training compute meters drop.

feynman_certification.listener_verdict: This immediately grabbed me. The ticker-tape visual and pointing out that GPUs were sitting idle waiting for word four made the RNN bottleneck instantly click. Beat 4 explains QKV without turning it into baby talk or overcomplicating the math—it just tells me straight up that it's a matrix multiplication mapping relationships across the entire sequence at once. No textbook intro, no corporate fluff.
